'''2003 Minnesota State Championship Parker Kienholz LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Parker Kienholz]] at [[2003 Minnesota State Championship]]; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Parker "Sparky1" Kienholz (2003-06-24).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=29406 I Don't Fear The Finger of Death---LS States]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050525171048/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=29406&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
